_doc: HW1 theme letter -> AE theme. 'walls' is the folder under doodads/walls/, 'doors' the suffix of doodads/doors/door_*_<doors>.unit, 'env' the lighting environment used when a level is mostly this theme. 'hw1_origins' marks themes whose AE pieces kept HW1's names and origins, so the measured wall offsets don't apply (AE's bonus levels stack v sections 32 px apart with caps right after, as HW1 does). Letters a-d and the bonus themes were confirmed by pairing the HW1 and AE Castle Hammerwatch levels.
_temple: Temple of the Sun themes, by pairing HW1's campaign2 with AE's sun_temple: each letter's wall pieces land in one AE folder (e 811 paired hits in cave_desert, g 2770 in pyramid_inside, i 775 in pyramid_fancy); 'env' is what AE's levels of that theme use. 'pieces' are where AE built a theme differently, [AE piece, dx, dy] as paired (cave runs use h/v, not h_32/v_32; the fancy temple draws its upper-left corners with v). Theme f (crystal cave) has too few paired walls to confirm (22 placements), but AE's cave_crystal has exactly cave_desert's pieces and its floors pair 93-100 % with Krilith's crystal cave, so it takes e's rules. Theme h (outdoor desert, rebuilt as different cliff pieces) stays ported.
